column1: # Raw rows of the navigator sessions of work package S2.5 (run_s25_nav_ab.sh: arms base = the S1 head 56456a72 with the --container patch of analysis/bench, base2 = a second copy of base (the null), new = this package; order rotated every round, one process per arm and round, 60 rounds, 40 calls per process). One line per process: round, arm, then metric=value of the nav command (warm_median_s keeps the range of the warm calls: [minimum .. maximum]; the figure of a process is the minimum). Sets: "a1" = attempt 1 of the in-memory cells (build 17d1cee8), "a2" = attempt 2 of the in-memory cells (build 8c073a1f), "c1" = the file-backed cells (build 8c073a1f, their first 60-process measurement), "c2" = attempt 2 of the file-backed cells (build 9109af24, the final code of the package).
